{{Quote|Larik was using his Senate seat to become rich at the expense of our people and planet. He was willing to bleed Raxus dry, luring off-world companies to come in and industrialize the land. He was selling off our planet piece by piece, all from his comfortable residence on faraway Coruscant.|[[Semage]]|<ref name="TOTJ" />}}
'''Larik''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[senator]] who represented the [[planet]] [[Raxus Secundus]] in the [[Galactic Senate|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic]]. Due to his corrupt nature, he was caught in a coup by his own [[Bodyguard|guards]], who wished to use him for Raxus' benefit. As such, he was [[Death|killed]] by his guards after revealing their coup to [[Jedi Master]]s [[Dooku]] and [[Mace Windu]].<ref name="TOTJ" />

==Biography==
At some point between [[50 BBY]] and [[48 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Larik served as the Senator of the Outer Rim planet [[Raxus Secundus]]. During that time, he used his Senate seat to become rich at the expense of the planet by encouraging otherworldly companies to industrialize it. At some point, his corruption was discovered by a group of his guards led by a man named Semage, who killed Larik's Jedi protector, Master [[Katri]], a member of the [[Jedi Council]], by ambushing her. However, Semage and his followers spared Larik with the intent to force him to enact their own rules at the next Senate hearing meeting in order to repair the damage Larik had done to Raxus.<ref name="TOTJ" />

When [[Jedi Master]]s Mace Windu and Count Dooku landed on Raxus Secundus to investigate the death of Master [[Katri]], a [[Jedi High Council|Council]] member, an official was there to greet them. He took them to see the senator. Larik told the Jedi that Katri was ambushed and that he was there at the time of Katri's death. Due to his awkward way of talking, the two Jedi did not believe his story, but Mace Windu decided that he and Dooku should stick to the plan and just retrieve Katri's body, not start a full investigation.<ref name="TOTJ" />

When they arrived at the place of Katri's death, the pair found out from the traces left that there were more than one attacker, and that there were no blast marks on the ship. When Dooku ignited his lightsaber and demanded the truth, a terrified Larik cried out that the guards killed Master Katri, and he was shot before he could reach Windu and Dooku.<ref name="TOTJ" />
